item.title: Behavioral & HR Interview Questions & Answers
item.author: Author
item.description: Introduce about yourself Firstly, Thank you for taking the time to review my CV. Regarding myself, I graduated with a degree in Software Engineering. I have been working for about six years in software development, focusing primarily on backend technologies and cloud services. Throughout my career, I have focused not just on coding but also on mentoring junior developers and promoting best practices in code quality and version control. Most recently, I worked at VPBank, where I contributed to the development of their loyalty system.
